info.name: GoGreen AI API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the GoGreen AI Spring Boot backend. Only includes APIs that exist in the project (Authentication, User profile, and Admin). All Admin endpoints require a Bearer JWT with the ADMIN role. Import the companion environment 'GoGreen AI - Local' and run the login requests first to populate token variables.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Registration, login, token refresh, logout, password reset, and email verification flows. Successful logins store the access token into the corresponding environment variable.

request.description:
Creates a new customer account and returns JWT access/refresh tokens.

Auth: none
Body: name, username, email, password, confirmPassword, phoneNumber (optional)
Responses: 201 Created | 400 Bad Request (duplicate email/username or validation)

Test: verifies 201 and stores accessToken into customerToken.

Submits a nursery owner registration for admin approval.

Auth: none
Body: name, username, email, password, confirmPassword, phoneNumber (optional)
Responses: 201 Created | 400 Bad Request

Submits a gardening expert registration for admin approval.

Auth: none
Body: name, username, email, password, confirmPassword, phoneNumber (optional)
Responses: 201 Created | 400 Bad Request

Submits a delivery partner registration for admin approval.

Auth: none
Body: name, username, email, password, confirmPassword, phoneNumber (optional)
Responses: 201 Created | 400 Bad Request

Authenticates an admin user and returns JWT access/refresh tokens.

Auth: none
Body: usernameOrEmail, password
Responses: 200 OK | 401 Unauthorized (bad credentials)

Test: verifies accessToken and stores into adminToken.

Authenticates a customer and returns JWT tokens.

Auth: none
Body: usernameOrEmail, password
Responses: 200 OK | 401 Unauthorized

Test: stores accessToken into customerToken.

Authenticates a nursery owner and returns JWT tokens.

Test: stores accessToken into nurseryOwnerToken.

Authenticates a gardening expert and returns JWT tokens.

Test: stores accessToken into expertToken.

Authenticates a delivery partner and returns JWT tokens.

Test: stores accessToken into deliveryPartnerToken.

Issues a new access token using a valid refresh token.

Auth: none
Body: refreshToken
Responses: 200 OK | 401 Unauthorized (invalid/expired)

Logs out the authenticated user.

Auth: Bearer token (any role)
Responses: 200 OK | 401 Unauthorized

Initiates a password reset for the given email.

Auth: none
Body: email
Responses: 200 OK | 400 Bad Request

Resets the password using a reset token.

Auth: none
Body: token, newPassword, confirmPassword (must match)
Responses: 200 OK | 400 Bad Request

Changes the authenticated user's password.

Auth: Bearer token (any role)
Body: currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword (must match)
Responses: 200 OK | 400 Bad Request

Requests email verification for the given email.

Auth: none
Body: email
Responses: 200 OK | 400 Bad Request

Verifies an OTP for the given email.

Auth: none
Body: email, otp
Responses: 200 OK | 400 Bad Request

Negative test: authenticating with invalid credentials.

Expected: 401 Unauthorized

exec: pm.test("Status is 401 for invalid login", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description:
Negative test: registering with an already-used email.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (duplicate email)

exec: pm.test("Status is 400 for duplicate email", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description:
Negative test: registration with missing/invalid required fields.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (validation error)

exec: pm.test("Status is 400 for validation errors", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: Admin
item.description: Administrative workflows protected by hasRole('ADMIN'). All requests use Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}}.

item.name: Admin Dashboard

request.description:
Returns overall dashboard counts.

item.name: Security Tests
item.description: Verify role-based access control on a protected admin endpoint.

request.description:
Negative test: calling an admin endpoint without any token.

Expected: 401 Unauthorized

Negative test: calling an admin endpoint with a customer token.

Expected: 403 Forbidden (insufficient role)

Positive test: calling an admin endpoint with a valid admin token.

Expected: 200 OK

Test: verifies 200 and success field.

Negative test: calling an admin endpoint with an invalid JWT.

Expected: 401 Unauthorized

Negative test: fetching a non-existent user.

Expected: 404 Not Found

exec: pm.test("Status is 404 Not Found", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });

request.description:
Negative test: creating a category with a duplicate name.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (duplicate category)

exec: pm.test("Status is 400 Bad Request", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
